title: StrictLocalMateProjectionFormulas
statement: For every f:X→S, geometric point s, K in D⁺(Ab(X_et)), integer n, and Q as in [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-neighbourhood-geometry], stage hypercohomology identifications compatible with neighbourhood transitions and the canonical mate projection restrictions exist [def-weil-pbc-strict-local-mate-projection-data]. No colimit or invertibility assertion is made.

source.place: Tags 03Q9, 03Q8 and 0BKV; neighbourhood colimit and final injective-complex paragraph

proof.text:
choose a bounded below injective representative J of K. Under derived adjunction,
Hom(Z[V][0], (Rf_*K)[n]) is Hom(f^*Z[V][0], K[n]); the free sheaf f^*Z[V] corepresents
sections on V ×_S X. Restriction along its etale projection to X preserves injectives,
so this derived Hom is the n-th hypercohomology of the restricted complex J.
These identifications provide e. Precomposition by a neighbourhood morphism is the
restriction of sections; express this restriction using the derived unit, Leray,
and the exact inverse-image composition isomorphism to obtain transition.
For the limit projection, evaluate the adjunction mate on J: its sections map is
inverse-image restriction along the pullback square. The canonical cohomology germ
map is taking the homology class of that same section. The first leg equation for Q
identifies the representative germ restriction with the limit projection. Exact
inverse image commutes with homology, and exact strict-local sections followed by
Leray give strictLocalBaseChangeTargetIso. Thus the two composites agree on every
derived section, proving restriction. Naturality of all the comparisons transports
the formulas from J to K. No continuity or invertibility of the mate is used.

mathlib_searches.query: Geometric stalk of higher direct image as colimit of cohomology of affine etale neighbourhoods with restriction map to strict henselization
mathlib_searches.results: Eight results about structure-sheaf stalks and ordinary module pullback; none realizes these abelian derived-section maps. Loogle presheafToSheaf, homology and IsPullback, IsAffineHom queries returned no hits.

Mathlib has general stalk and pullback infrastructure, but no strict-local derived mate or the canonical derived Hom-to-germ comparison. The existing AbelianHigherDirectImagePresheaf has private definitions of the comparison, inaccessible from another module.
